info.title: SuryaSetu API
info.description: PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar marketplace. Every number comes from `rules/`.

post.description: Public. Sends a login code. In local mode the code is `DEMO_OTP`.
Public. Exchanges the code for a JWT. A new phone must choose `household` or `vendor`.

Multipart upload to the local `uploads/` folder. Photos lose their metadata.

Production swaps the folder for presigned object storage behind the same response.

get.description: The owner, an admin, or a vendor viewing that request's terrace photo.

post.description:
Queues `voice_extract` for an uploaded voice note. Poll the job for a `VoiceResult`.

The fields prefill the form for the household to check. Pass `entity_id` as
`voice_input_id` when submitting the request. Limited to 10 voice notes an hour.

Opens a request. Sizing and subsidy are calculated in code and returned at once.

With a photo, the roof assessment starts in the background and shows as `pending`; when it
finishes, the estimate is recalculated from the usable roof area.

get.description:
Open and quoted requests inside the viewport and the vendor's service radius.

Pins sit at the rounded location, newest first. Without a base location the radius
is not applied and distances are empty.

parameters.name: bbox

schema.description: Map viewport as west,south,east,north in degrees.
schema.title: Bbox

parameters.description: Map viewport as west,south,east,north in degrees.

get.description:
The owner gets `RequestOut`; a vendor gets `VendorRequestView`. Check `view`.

Vendors see open and quoted requests, and any request they have quoted.

schema.title: Response Get Request Requests  Request Id  Get

post.description:
Saves the quote with net cost and payback from code, then queues `quote_review`.

Missing items and warnings are checked in code at once; the AI notes follow later.
409 when the request is not open or quoted, or this vendor has already quoted it.

get.description: Every quote on the household's request, best score first, with each score explained.

post.description:
Queues `recommend`, or returns the existing job while the quotes are unchanged.

Code ranks the quotes; the AI only explains the ranking, and a template takes over if the
AI is down. 409 when there are no quotes yet.

get.description: The latest recommendation. `stale` is true once a quote has changed since.
The vendor's quotes, newest first. Household contact appears once a quote is accepted.

post.description:
One transaction: this quote accepted, the others rejected, the request accepted.

Returns the vendor's contact. The vendor sees the household's contact from then on.
409 when the request is no longer quoted, including the loser of two simultaneous accepts.

get.description: Polling fallback for clients without SSE. Only the user who started a job can read it.
Server-Sent Events for the signed-in user.
Public. The rule set and its sources, for the "where does this number come from" panel.

key.title: Key
key.description: Stable id for translating the label, e.g. `annual_saving`.

value.title: Value
value.description: Display value; `never` when there is no payback.

CalcStep.title: CalcStep
CalcStep.description: One line of working from `rules.steps.Step`, rendered with an ⓘ link to its rule.

payback_years.title: Payback Years
payback_years.description: Empty when the system saves nothing.

CalculationOut.title: CalculationOut
CalculationOut.description: A row of `calculations`: the request estimate, or one quote's financials.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One SSE message. The `event:` line carries `type`; the `data:` line carries this JSON.

HouseholdContact.title: HouseholdContact
HouseholdContact.description: Shared with a vendor only after that vendor's quote is accepted.

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: The row the job will fill in.

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted
JobAccepted.description: Returned with 202. Follow progress on `GET /jobs/{id}` or the SSE stream.

included.title: Included
included.description: False lists the item as excluded.

bbox_x.title: Bbox X
bbox_x.description: Box position and size as fractions of the image.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Empty until the vendor sets a base location.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page.

PrefillFields.title: PrefillFields
PrefillFields.description: What the LLM heard. The household confirms each value; nothing is posted automatically.

QuoteComparison.title: QuoteComparison
QuoteComparison.description: All quotes on one request, ranked by `rules.scoring`. Capped at 50 quotes per request.

dcr_compliant.title: Dcr Compliant
dcr_compliant.description: Domestic content panels, required for the subsidy.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Untrusted. Shown to the household, never used to rank.

QuoteReviewOut.title: QuoteReviewOut
QuoteReviewOut.description: `missing_items`, `warnings` and the injection check come from code; `llm_notes` is text.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why the top quote leads, in plain words.

other_notes.title: Other Notes
other_notes.description: One line per other quote, keyed by quote id.

written_by.title: Written By
written_by.description: `template` when the AI was unavailable or its text failed the checks.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when quotes changed since this was written.

RecommendationOut.title: RecommendationOut
RecommendationOut.description: Ranking from `rules.scoring`. The LLM writes the reasons from the score table only.

discom_id.title: Discom Id
discom_id.description: Sets the subsidy category. Without it, the general rates apply.

RoofAssessmentOut.title: RoofAssessmentOut
RoofAssessmentOut.description: `usable_fraction` and obstructions come from the LLM; areas and the kW cap from code.

contact.description: Set once this quote is accepted.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Empty until the vendor sets a base location.

contact.description: Set once this vendor's quote is accepted.

VendorRequestView.title: VendorRequestView
VendorRequestView.description: A vendor's view. The location is rounded to about 500 m and there is no phone number.

role.title: Role
role.description: Required the first time a phone signs in; ignored afterwards.
